EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 7
My No.: Ser/5/5/19/Projects/Land.acq.(Ho/2017/03)
Land Ministry No.: 4-3/9/2014/IR/348 C

I, hereby notify under Sub-section (1) of the Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendments) Act, No. 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired: Boundaries to the land lots of 171.1228 Hectares with below mentioned names and extents shown in Cadastral map dated 30.08.2017 prepared for allotments of lands 1-187 in pages 1-26 of the list of land description of Sheet No. 01, zone No. 06, No. 110428 of Survey General situated in the Village of Puliyankulama in the Grama Niladhari’s Division of the No. 144, Wahalkada D01 in the Minor Division of Hurulu Palatha Central of the Divisional Secretariat of Horowpathana in the District of Anuradhapura in the North Central Province.
